policy: Dependency audit gate (DPP 2.7, docs/security/vulnerability-management.md). Critical advisories are never allowed. High advisories are allowed only with an entry here and only until the entry's due date; past the date the gate fails until the fix ships or the operator records a new risk decision with a new date. Moderate and low advisories are reported, not gated. Every entry names the fix that closes it.

entries.reason: Leading-zero octet decoding in Address4. NivaDesk only calls geoip.lookup(ip) on the request address for a country hint; the parsing quirk changes at most the geo answer, never an access decision.
entries.fix: geoip-lite 1.x -> 2.0.3 (major; resolves ip-address ^10.2.0). Separate backlog item, see vulnerability-management.md.

entries.reason: Arbitrary file read via source-map handling at build time. PostCSS runs only during the Hostinger build over NivaDesk's own stylesheets; no untrusted CSS reaches it.
entries.fix: next 15 -> 16.3.4 (major). Separate backlog item, see vulnerability-management.md.
